fixture: Eleven authored synthetic numeric samples; no devices or accounts

scenarios.name: real Moxi replay
scenarios.steps: Open consumer; advance all 11 samples; compare returned SVG with mounted paths.
scenarios.expected: Fixed table widths, holds and no-jump anchors; final Next disabled; compiled Moxi SVG only.
scenarios.observed: All eleven states and widths match; both paths are Moxi response bytes.

scenarios.name: keyboard and narrow layout
scenarios.steps: Tab/Shift+Tab and Enter: release, advance, reengage, advance at 390 px.
scenarios.expected: Every replay action reachable; no-jump reengagement; no horizontal overflow.
scenarios.observed: Held at 12/12; anchored at 12/12; resumed 18/14.5 px; no overflow.

scenarios.name: author, validate, save and reopen
scenarios.steps: Enter applies edited corners/curve; Escape reverts; reject 29 px; Cmd+S saves; reload and Ctrl+O reopen; reopen in a new page; reject bad saved version; loss/recovery replay.
scenarios.expected: No jump on apply; persisted calibration drives different rendered widths; rejected edits leave state intact.
scenarios.observed: Apply held 24/18.25. Reopened sample 4 rendered 20/17.6875. Loss held, reacquisition anchored; sample 8 resumed 17.28/15.2275.

scenarios.name: render rejection and recovery
scenarios.steps: Synthetic 503 after a good scene; retry. Synthetic 503 at startup; Restart retries.
scenarios.expected: Keep prior frame and rendered state after failure; no brushes when Moxi never rendered; recover via retry.
scenarios.observed: Failed Next stayed at sample 8; retry reached 9. Failed startup showed zero paths and disabled Next; Restart restored Moxi.

scenarios.name: offline deck
scenarios.steps: Disconnect network; open generated file deck; decode images and navigate with keyboard/contact sheet.
scenarios.expected: All images load offline and navigation works.
scenarios.observed: All 11 captures decoded; keyboard and contact sheet navigation passed.
